text:
Maya: Quick sync — planning launch posts + webinar for 'Benchmarks & Quickstarts' next Wed. Want to tie in a PLG microexperiment: gated starter credits + prompt-template quickstart + 1-click onboarding nudge. Thoughts? :tada:
Sam: Love it. Recommend two funnels: 'trial-credit' and 'lite-credit' segmented by signup signal. We'll run staggered credit amounts 50 vs 150.
Sam: Tracking plan — add utm_experiment=bench_launch & utm_variant={A|B}. I'll set up experiment keys and routing flags. :white_check_mark:
Sam: 
```
exp_name=bench_launch_2026
variants=A,B
metric=activation_7d
utm_source=launch_post
```
Jordan: Copy brainstorm — short social cards + 2 webinar CTAs. Keeping social hooks punchy.
Jordan: Variant A headline: 'Ship LLM features faster — 30min workshop + starter credits'
Jordan: Variant B headline: 'Lower inference costs: live benchmark + hands-on promptpack'
Jordan: I'll drop 3 alt hero images and 4 short captions in the doc.
Lee: Heads up on tracking — we need events for: signup, credit_claimed, first_prompt_use, and reply_rate. Recommend GA + internal event bridge. KPI set: 7d activation, tokens_used_week1, retention_day7.
Nicole: For inbound routing, can we auto-route accounts to Sales if token_projection > 100k? Also want a canary rollout for credit amounts (to avoid abuse).
Maya: Good call. @Sam can you add cohort routing rules in the experiment sheet? @Lee can you own the metric dashboard? @Jordan please finalize copy by Tue EOD. :clock10:
Sam: On it. I'll add routing flags: sales_flag=true if projected>100k and add a hold for manual review for enterprise suspects.
Jordan: Writing the prompt-template quickstart now. Example prompt snippet: 
```
System: You are a concise code assistant optimized for refactors.
User: Refactor this function to be more efficient while preserving behavior.
```
Jordan: We'll A/B test template variants: 'refactor-first' vs 'explain-first'.
GrowthBot: experiment 'bench_launch_2026' created by Sam. Variant A: 50 credits, Variant B: 150 credits. Tracking hooks attached.
Lee: Schedule a post-launch review 7 days after release. I'll set automated alerts: if activation_delta >= 8% we promote winner; if negative, rollback credit increase.
Maya: Meeting 10:30am Tue to finalize assets; calendar invite sent. Keep threads short in the doc and call out blockers early. :+1:
Sam: Ping @Nicole — routing rules doc: https://redwood/doc/experiment-routing (will add examples).
Nicole: Added note about KYC flow. If enterprise signal present, override automated credits and require manual QA and SSO check.
Maya: Perfect. Final checklist pasted to the doc: copy, assets, utm setup, dashboard, routing rules, canary plan. Anything else?
Jordan: Need webinar slide speaker bio — @Maya can you share?
Maya: Shared in Drive (link in doc). Also adding a tiny onboarding nudge: 1st prompt template + CTA to claim credits after first successful completion.
Sam: I'll wire up the experiment flags and add a small throttling rule to limit claims per IP for the first 48h.
Lee: I'll add dashboards and the funnel viz. Will surface cohort breakdown by signup_source and region.
Maya: Thanks team — let's ship tidy. If any blockers, drop them here before EOD Mon.
